title: HEALING
BALM
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters at dawn
warm golden sanctuary light filtering through trees
gentle white dove resting in peaceful olive branches
calm river flowing softly through green valleys
serene morning sunlight on quiet mountain lake
soft golden light illuminating peaceful waters
tranquil nature scene with gentle morning mist
peaceful stream reflecting bright morning sky

scenes.a: If your chest feels tight with anxiety you cannot name, pause and listen.
Lord, meet this weary heart right now with your abiding grace.
The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
We bring our heavy sorrows before your throne in quiet trust.
The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
Surround every fearful thought with your gentle and restoring presence.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
Grant us deep rest in your holy word today.
